en: Psalms 90
A Prayer by Moses, the man of God.
90:0 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim).

p.src: 1  Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

en: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.
u.src: 1  Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

en: 90:1 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”

p.src: 2  Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

en: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.
u.src: 2  Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

p.src: 3  You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”

en: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”
u.src: 3  You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”

p.src: 4  For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

en: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
u.src: 4  For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

p.src: 5  You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

en: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
u.src: 5  You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

p.src: 6  In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

en: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.
u.src: 6  In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

p.src: 7  For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

en: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
u.src: 7  For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

p.src: 8  You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

en: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.
u.src: 8  You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

p.src: 9  For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

en: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.
u.src: 9  For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

p.src: 10  The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

en: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.
u.src: 10  The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

p.src: 11  Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

en: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?
u.src: 11  Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

p.src: 12  So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

en: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.
u.src: 12  So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

p.src: 13  Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

en: Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!
u.src: 13  Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

en: 90:13 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 14  Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

en: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
u.src: 14  Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

p.src: 15  Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

en: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
u.src: 15  Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

p.src: 16  Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.

en: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.
u.src: 16  Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.

p.src: 17  Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.

en: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
u.src: 17  Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.
